content.text:
The logic is split across two layers: detection happens when credentials are built, and the copyable text is formatted in the receipt service.

**Building the copyable text**
- `src/services/receipt.service.ts:538-547` is the main place. It treats a credential as an activation link if `cred.format === "activation_link"` or `cred.itemType === "activation_link"` (a further condition continues on line 541, which I didn't read). It then writes the plain-text lines `Format / Type : Activation Link / One-Time Invite` and `Activation URL : …`.

**Detecting activation links**
- `src/vault/entitlement.service.ts:636, 713, 790, 815` is where delivered credentials are built. The `isLink` flag sets `format: "activation_link"` and `label: "Activation Link"`. This is the main source of the `format` value the receipt reads.
- `src/reseller/reseller.service.ts:1643, 2513, 2715` uses `item_type === "activation_link"` or a payload starting with `http://` or `https://`.
- `src/integrations/suppliers/drivers/warzoneshop.driver.ts:216` marks supplier-delivered items as `activation_link` when the raw value starts with `http`.
- `src/services/manual-order.service.ts:738, 866` checks `row.item_type === "activation_link"`.
- `src/services/supplier-deposit.service.ts:644-657` handles the `formatMode` setting for stock deposits.

The `item_type` and `format_mode` values come from the vault schema in `src/db/migrations/031_multi_type_vault_and_stock_rpc.sql` and `040_supplier_deposits_schema.sql`.

I only searched for the keywords, so I haven't read these functions end to end. Start with `entitlement.service.ts` around line 636 and `receipt.service.ts` around line 538.
